invariant_text: Every distribution extracts to an independent repository with preserved canonical source and package digests.
method: Copied src/python/ubl/ verbatim (186 files, excluding build/.pytest_cache/etc.) into a fresh OS-temp directory with no ancestor relationship to this repository, confirmed byte-identical against the original, built a wheel+sdist from that isolated copy with its own cwd (never this repository root), built a second wheel+sdist from the in-place source at the same pinned SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, and compared artifact digests.
note: Clean on the first run for THIS gate, despite this format's own build/ directory having 155 stray files (the most of any FF6 format) -- the fix already applied to this gate's own _build() clears it before comparing. Separately, this format's own PRE-EXISTING reports/certification/ubl/reproducible-build.json was found stale and was refreshed this same tick using the now-fixed reproducible_build_gate.py -- the two now agree exactly. A THIRD, separate and still-open finding: tools/run_package_install_proof.py (invoked with the system python on PATH, not .venv/Scripts/python.exe) produced a DIFFERENT wheel digest for ubl (9f0aeab8...) than this gate and reproducible_build_gate.py (both pinned to .venv/Scripts/python.exe, digest 86a247c8...) -- confirmed NOT a build/-cache issue (both interpreters produce stable, self-consistent output across repeated runs), but a genuine build-environment-pinning inconsistency across the certification tooling (which python resolves build-time dependencies matters for byte-for-byte reproducibility). Disclosed honestly, not fixed this tick -- a separate, bounded follow-up. This is one of product-goal.yaml's own completion invariants, separate from the 10-item gate list (installed-wheel, independent-oracle, corpus, security, resource, typing, documentation, compatibility, performance, reproducible-build). Not a certification claim -- the other outstanding program-wide invariant (all-six-co-install, already separately satisfied at FF6-EVENT-000322) and this format's own remaining obligation/gate work are tracked independently.
